description: This file defines the RemoteGrainDirectory class, a component within Orleans Runtime responsible for managing remote grain registrations, lookups, and unregistrations, serving as part of the distributed grain directory infrastructure.

classes.name: RemoteGrainDirectory
classes.description: Sealed internal class that handles remote grain directory operations such as registration, lookup, and removal of grain addresses across distributed nodes.

methods.name: RegisterAsync
methods.description: Registers a grain address remotely, with overload supporting optional hop count.

methods.name: UnregisterAsync
methods.description: Unregisters a specific grain address remotely.

methods.name: DeleteGrainAsync
methods.description: Deletes a grain from the directory.

methods.name: LookupAsync
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous lookup for a grain by ID.

methods.name: LookUpMany
methods.description: Performs batch lookup for multiple grains.

methods.name: AcceptSplitPartition
methods.description: Handles acceptance of a split partition with a list of existing activations.
